patches_modified.description: Skips automatic consent, startup login and topic-notification prompts. Defaults to guest reading and manual notification opt-in while retaining city selection, saved choices and manual login/privacy controls.

patches_added.name: Android Auto show grid browse
patches_added.description: Rebuilds the Android Auto browse around podcast series and opens it to every car client. The For-you episode sections become grids of series covers; opening a series lists its episodes newest-first through the app's own paginated query, so playback, queueing and entitlement keep running through unmodified Podimo code. The library tab disappears for guests with nothing saved locally. Any media-browser client may connect: the app's certificate-pinned caller allowlist is replaced with a lookup that serves the full section tree to every caller, including Android Automotive, desktop head units and aftermarket clients.

patches_modified.name: Guest session playback host
patches_modified.description: Points the app's production GraphQL API at Podimo's website host (https://graphql.podimo.com/graphql). The Android gateway host (https://graphql.pdm-gateway.com) rejected guest-session playback requests with HTTP 403 in the supplied analysis, while the website host served the app's own guest registration, profile and single-episode playback operations and returned signed full-length audio for Premium-labelled episodes to a fresh, unregistered guest with a FREE subscription. With this patch the app registers its guest session and requests playback URLs through the verified host; transport security, authentication headers, request signing and error handling stay untouched. Staging and localhost routes are not affected.

patches_modified.name: Unlock Premium playback
patches_modified.description: Replaces every Premium button with the app's existing play button and lets its normal play action run for Premium, Premium Plus, Premium-only episodes and exclusive podcasts, including without an account. The app derives the button, the paywall navigation and the playback permission from one user access validator; this patch returns its typed success result at that single boundary, so the episode rows render the standard play button and the play action reaches the app's own signed playback query. The server still decides whether to return a playback URL, and account data, profile fields and subscription states are not modified. The top-left "Start free trial" promotion pill and its sibling upsell labels are hidden with the app's own invisible banner.

patches_added.description: Restores build-specific startup data, lifecycle helpers, authentication and media/network callbacks. Preserves genuine token and entitlement checks and retains other protected native callbacks.

patches_added.name: Blur behind menus
patches_added.description: Blurs the screen behind the menu you get when you press and hold a chat, and behind Messenger's other pop-up menus and sheets, like on an iPhone. Needs Android 12 or newer. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Fix videos in chat heads
patches_added.description: Draws videos in a chat head like the rest of the chat instead of on a separate layer, which some phones showed as a black box that stayed on screen after the chat head closed. Videos in the app itself are left as they are.

patches_added.name: Live captions on calls
patches_added.description: Shows what the other people say during a call as captions over Messenger. Your phone makes them itself, and it can translate them into your language and read them aloud. It needs Android 13 or newer with speech recognition on the phone. While it's on, calls use Android's regular audio path instead of Messenger's own, and Messenger needs a restart after you change it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Send Instants from your gallery
patches_added.description: Tapping the shutter in Instants opens your phone's gallery app instead of taking a photo. The photo you pick goes out as the Instant, cut to the camera's shape. Back out of the gallery and nothing is sent. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Special contacts
patches_added.description: Adds Track this person to the menu you get when you press and hold a chat with one person. HushMessenger then keeps a history of when they come online, go offline, type to you and change their name, from what Messenger already shows you. The history stays on this phone, and you can read it in HushMessenger settings. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Ask before a call
patches_modified.description: Tapping an audio or video call button asks first, so a stray tap doesn't ring anyone. That covers a chat's top bar, business chats and the New message screen. Call starts it, Cancel doesn't. Calls coming in aren't affected. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
patches_modified.previous_description: Tapping the audio or video call button in a chat's top bar asks first, so a stray tap doesn't ring anyone. Call starts it, Cancel doesn't. Calls coming in aren't affected. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: GmsCore support
patches_modified.description: Gets Messenger's push notifications through microG-RE instead of Google Play services. It also gives microG-RE the signature of Meta's own Messenger for the Google services that check one. Only for phones with microG-RE installed, since Messenger stops asking Google Play services. Install microG-RE before you open the patched app. Pick it in Morphe Manager's Expert mode. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Hide call buttons
patches_modified.description: Takes the audio and video call buttons out of a chat's top bar, business chats and the New message screen, so you can't tap one by accident. Calls still ring, and you can still join one that's going. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Keep a message log
patches_modified.description: Saves each message when its notification arrives, so you can still read it if it's unsent, and marks the ones that were. Works in end-to-end encrypted chats too. Stays on your phone. A clock next to the new message button in Chats can open the log too, and so can a row in the menu you get when you press and hold a chat, which opens just that chat's messages. patches_modified.name: Disable auto feed refresh

patches_modified.name: Disable haptic feedback

patches_modified.name: Disable layout updates

patches_modified.name: Disable player popup panels

patches_modified.name: Disable playlist autoplay

patches_modified.name: Disable rolling number animations

patches_modified.name: Disable scrolling speed limit

patches_modified.name: Disable sign in to TV popup

patches_modified.name: Disable video codecs

patches_modified.name: Downloads

patches_modified.name: Enable debugging

patches_modified.name: Exit fullscreen mode

patches_modified.name: Force fullscreen landscape

patches_modified.name: Force original audio

patches_modified.name: Fullscreen video scale

patches_modified.description: Adds Save to the menu you get by pressing and holding a comment that has its own photo, GIF or sticker, saving the largest size Instagram sent. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Disable Google Engage worker

patches_modified.name: Show pin image information
patches_modified.description: Shows optional image dimensions and format below the image or instead of like/comment actions.

patches_modified.name: Use the system share sheet
patches_modified.description: Opens the Android system share sheet instead of Pinterest's in-app share sheet, when the matching Morphe setting is enabled.

patches_modified.name: Choose startup tab
patches_modified.description: Choose Home, Search or Saved for fresh launcher starts. Keeps deep links, notifications and restored sessions unchanged. Configure in Morphe settings.

patches_modified.name: Copy direct link
patches_modified.description: Adds a "Copy direct link" option to the pin menu, copying the direct CDN media link instead of the Pinterest web link.

patches_modified.name: Disable AppsFlyer tracking
patches_modified.description: Neutralises the AppsFlyer attribution SDK, so no install, event or uninstall data leaves the device.

patches_modified.name: Disable Google Engage
patches_modified.description: Stops Pinterest publishing your content to Google (Discover, Assistant, Play Store).

patches_modified.name: Disable Google Engage worker
patches_modified.description: Blocks the periodic Google Engage job, the other way content reaches Google.

patches_modified.name: Disable ads
patches_modified.description: Removes sponsored pins from the home, search, related and board feeds. Also carries the "Hide product pins" and "Hide board modules in search" filters, and the opt-in "Hide video pins" filter and the default-on "Hide AI-labeled Pins" filter, all switchable from the Morphe settings screen.

patches_modified.name: Disable email confirmation dialog
patches_modified.description: Closes the "confirm your email" modal, and similar ones, when enabled in Morphe settings.

patches_modified.name: Disable third-party trackers
patches_modified.description: Turns off the embedded advertising and telemetry SDKs (AdMob, Bugsnag, Firebase, Privacy Sandbox) and strips the Advertising ID permission. This patch leaves Firebase Messaging enabled.

patches_modified.name: Download board
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to the board's "…" menu to bulk download the images and videos of the loaded pins.

patches_modified.name: Download images in highest available quality
patches_modified.description: Checks for an original image before downloading, with automatic fallback to the largest available app variant.

patches_modified.name: Download pin from long press
patches_modified.description: Adds a download button to the circular menu you get by long-pressing a pin, so the image can be saved without opening it.

patches_modified.name: Download video
patches_modified.description: Adds a "Download video" option to the pin menu, saving the clip to the Downloads folder.

patches_modified.name: Filter pin menu actions
patches_modified.description: Hides selected native pin menu actions by their localized labels, one per line.

patches_modified.name: GmsCore support for Pinterest
patches_modified.description: Enables Google sign-in and push registration through microG-RE when available. Email sign-in remains available.
patches_modified.previous_description: Routes Google sign-in and push registration to microG-RE. Select only with a configured microG-RE installation.

patches_modified.name: Hide Notifications nav button
patches_modified.description: Hides the notifications navigation button, when enabled in Morphe settings.

patches_modified.name: Hide Search nav button
patches_modified.description: Hides the search navigation button, when enabled in Morphe settings.

patches_modified.name: Hide ad views

patches_modified.name: Hide comments

patches_modified.name: Hide greeting header buttons

patches_modified.name: Hide save for later tooltip
patches_modified.description: Always hides the save-for-later education popup without disabling the Save button.

patches_modified.name: Hide screenshot share menu
patches_modified.description: Removes the panel Pinterest opens after a screenshot, and stops it watching for screenshots where possible.

patches_modified.name: Hide search history

patches_modified.name: Keep Home feed

patches_added.name: Choose what the bottom bar shows
patches_added.description: Lets each item on the bottom navigation bar — Posts, Actions, Explore and Inbox — be left alone, taken off, or replaced with one of the actions from Sync's own actions sheet, and adds one further button beside them. Covers the navigation rail used in tablet mode as well.

patches_added.name: Clone Sync app
patches_added.description: Changes the app package name so that the app can be installed more than once, with ".morphe" appended to it unless another name is given. Each cloned install needs a package name of its own. Use this rather than the universal "Clone app" patch, which leaves the app unable to read or write anything once its providers are renamed, and select only one of the two.

patches_added.name: Play a YouTube video where Sync's player cannot
patches_added.description: Plays the video in a web view when Sync's YouTube player fails to start, which it now always does: the player asks the official YouTube app for a service Google has removed. Covers the player in a link's sheet and the full screen one.

patches_added.name: Repair a gallery Reddit says has failed
patches_added.description: Finds the pictures of a gallery that opens empty because Reddit marked them as failed, by asking i.redd.it for them, and leaves a gallery with nothing wrong untouched.

patches_added.name: Stack a link post's picture over its title in columns
patches_added.description: Draws a link post's picture across the top of its card with the title underneath where the feed is in more than one column, instead of beside the title in the width that is left over.

patches_added.name: Change package name
patches_added.description: Gives the patched Pinterest its own package name and app name (HushPinterest unless you pick another), so it installs beside the Pinterest you already have instead of over it. It's a separate app with its own sign-in. It isn't selected by default. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_added.name: Hide Inbox updates
patches_added.description: Leaves the Updates section out of your Inbox, so it doesn't load. The pin ideas Pinterest puts there go, and so do the activity updates in that section. Your messages stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Notifications.

patches_added.name: Expand board list
patches_added.description: Opens the Save to sheet all the way up when you save a pin, so more of your boards show without dragging it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Hide suggested boards
patches_added.description: Hides the board Pinterest suggests under your own boards when you save a pin, such as one it offers to make for you. Your boards and Profile stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: AMOLED black
patches_modified.description: Paints the bottom bar pure black in dark mode, so it matches Pinterest's black pages on OLED screens. The comments sheet and a pin's menu can go black too, each with its own switch. Light mode stays as it is. Starts off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Disable analytics
patches_modified.description: Stops Pinterest from sending usage reports, crash reports and ad-tracking data to outside companies, and turns off Google's analytics inside the app. Good if you'd rather share less. On by default. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Disable update nag
patches_modified.description: Stops Pinterest's pop-ups asking you to update from the Play Store. You can still update Pinterest yourself. Good if the reminders get annoying. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Updates.

patches_modified.name: Download board
patches_modified.description: Adds Download board to a board's menu. It saves every pin Pinterest has loaded for that board, up to 500, and skips ones already in Download history, so you can keep a board without picking pins one at a time. Needs Download pins on too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Pin actions.

patches_modified.name: Download pins
patches_modified.description: Adds downloads for a pin, or for several pins you select in a grid. Saves the original image or the highest-quality video Pinterest supplies to your phone. When it saves an image, Pinterest's own Download image row is hidden. Downloads go to the Download folder. Turn on Save in Pinterest's folder to keep them in Pictures/100PINT/Pins with Pinterest's own saves, or use Pick a download folder to choose any folder inside Pictures, DCIM, Download or Documents. Starts off. Copy image puts an image pin's full-size picture on the clipboard, and Share image sends it through Android's share menu. Each has its own switch, also off. Save pins you download also saves a pin you download to your profile, and Download pins you save also downloads a pin you save. Those two start off as well. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Pin actions.

patches_modified.name: Filter feed
patches_modified.description: Lets you take video pins (photos and GIFs stay) and pins that mention words you mute out of your home feed, search, related pins and boards, and pins you've already saved and Pinterest's suggestion rows out of your home feed. Starts off. Set it up in HushPinterest settings > Feed.
patches_modified.previous_description: Lets you take video pins (photos and GIFs stay) and pins that mention words you mute out of your home feed, search, related pins and boards, and pins you've already saved out of your home feed. Starts off. Set it up in HushPinterest settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Filter pin menu
patches_modified.description: Lets you hide Add to collage, Remix collage, Search image and Promote pin in a pin's menu, each with its own switch. Download, share and copy link stay. Starts off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Fix push notifications
patches_modified.description: Lets the patched app sign up for push notifications. Google's Firebase service only signs Pinterest up when the request names Pinterest's original signature, so this sends that signature's fingerprint and changes nothing else in the request. On by default. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings > Notifications.

patches_modified.name: GmsCore support
patches_modified.description: Lets Google sign-in and push notifications go through microG-RE instead of Google Play services. Pick it only if microG-RE is on your phone. Without microG-RE, Google sign-in and push notifications stop working in the patched app. It brings Spoof signature for Google sign-in along. It isn't selected by default. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Hide AI-labeled pins
patches_modified.description: Removes pins that Pinterest labels as made or changed with AI from your home feed, search, related pins and boards. A second switch also takes unlabeled pins whose title or description calls them AI art, or that come from an AI image site. Other AI images still show. Both start off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide Assistant
patches_modified.description: Removes Pinterest's AI Assistant from search, boards and pins, so you don't get its buttons or its suggestion row. Regular search keeps working. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide ads
patches_modified.description: Removes promoted pins from your home feed, search, related pins and boards, and hides panels that only hold ads. Good for a cleaner feed. On by default. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide advertising ID
patches_modified.description: Pinterest sees an empty advertising ID with ad tracking limited, the same as if you deleted your advertising ID in Android. Pinterest also stops keeping its browser ID in Google's Block Store, so a reinstall doesn't bring the old one back. Good for keeping ads from following you. On by default. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Hide closeup buttons
patches_modified.description: Lets you hide the buttons on a pin you open, each with its own switch. That covers the back arrow and the visual search (lens) button that float over the picture, the like, comment, share and more buttons under it, the Remix button and the Visit site button. Another switch keeps the lens but drops its glow and the Search image label Pinterest puts on it for your first pins each day. Two more rows draw the red Save button smaller or paint it a color you pick. Your phone's back gesture still leaves the pin, and Search image in the pin menu still works. They all start off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide comments
patches_modified.description: Collapses the comments and comment previews under pins. It doesn't change who can comment on your pins. Good for a quieter pin page. A separate switch hides the suggested replies next to the comment box. Both start off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide header buttons
patches_modified.description: Hides the small icon buttons at the end of the top bar. Back buttons, text buttons and account controls stay. Good for a cleaner top bar. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide navigation buttons
patches_modified.description: Lets you hide the Create, Notifications and Search buttons in the bottom bar, each with its own switch. The Create and Notifications switches also cover those buttons at the top of Home. Home and Profile stay. Starts off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide save toasts
patches_modified.description: Stops the pop-up Pinterest shows after you save a pin, such as the Saved to your board message or a suggestion to follow the creator. The pin is still saved. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide search history
patches_modified.description: Hides your recent searches on the search screen of this phone. It doesn't delete your account's search history. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide shopping and product pins
patches_modified.description: Hides shoppable pins, shopping stories and featured boards. Good if you want to browse ideas, not products. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide survey prompts
patches_modified.description: Turns down Pinterest's "Got a minute?" survey invite before it pops up, the same way tapping Maybe later does, so the same survey doesn't come back. Advertiser-sponsored polls don't pop up either. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide topic suggestions
patches_modified.description: Hides the Ideas you might love row of topic bubbles under pins, without leaving a gap. Comments and related pins stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: HushPinterest settings
patches_modified.description: Adds a HushPinterest page to Pinterest where you turn features on or off, pause HushPinterest, back up your settings and read the licenses. Open it from Pinterest's settings, or by long-pressing the Pinterest logo at the top of your home feed or Pinterest's app icon. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Keep Home feed
patches_modified.description: Keeps your Home feed where you left it when you come back to Pinterest or to the Home tab, instead of loading new pins on its own. Pull down to refresh whenever you want new pins. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Long-press download
patches_modified.description: Adds a Download button to the menu you get when you long-press a pin in a grid, the round one and the newer list, so you can save a pin without opening it. Needs Download pins on too. Three more switches take Pinterest's Save, Send or Search image button out of that menu. All start off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Pin actions.

patches_modified.name: No screenshot share menu
patches_modified.description: Stops Pinterest from popping up sharing suggestions after you take a screenshot. Screenshots still work as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Open links in your browser
patches_modified.description: Opens a pin's Visit link and profile websites in your web browser. Pinterest links and sign-in work as before. Good if you prefer your own browser. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Links.

patches_modified.name: Original-quality images
patches_modified.description: Loads the original image for each pin and in collages, instead of the large size. Pictures look sharper but use more data. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Quiet email reminders
patches_modified.description: Dismisses the optional reminder to confirm your email. Account checks and sign-in still work as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Remove ad tracking permissions
patches_modified.description: Removes Google's advertising ID permission and Android's Privacy Sandbox ad services from Pinterest, so it can't use them. Google Play services then answers with zeros. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Show posted date
patches_modified.description: Shows the day a pin was posted under its title when you open it. Pinterest sends that date with every pin but never shows it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Spoof signature for Google sign-in
patches_modified.description: Helps Google sign-in work in the patched app by naming Pinterest's original signature. It only helps with microG-RE or the XSpoofSignatures module. Email sign-in doesn't need it. It isn't selected by default. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Strip link tracking
patches_modified.description: Removes tracking tags from links you copy or share from Pinterest. The link still goes to the same place. Its Plain pin links switch also turns short pin.it links into the pin's own pinterest.com link, so they don't show who shared them. Strip link tracking is on by default and Plain pin links starts off. Both are in HushPinterest settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: System share sheet
patches_modified.description: Uses Android's own share menu when you share a pin link. Screenshot and download actions work as before. Good if you want your usual share targets. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Pin actions.

patches_added.name: Change package name
patches_added.description: Gives the patched Pinterest its own package name and app name (HushPinterest unless you pick another), so it installs beside the Pinterest you already have instead of over it. It's a separate app with its own sign-in. It isn't selected by default. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_added.name: Hide Inbox updates
patches_added.description: Leaves the Updates section out of your Inbox, so it doesn't load. The pin ideas Pinterest puts there go, and so do the activity updates in that section. Your messages stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Notifications.

patches_added.name: Expand board list
patches_added.description: Opens the Save to sheet all the way up when you save a pin, so more of your boards show without dragging it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Hide suggested boards
patches_added.description: Hides the board Pinterest suggests under your own boards when you save a pin, such as one it offers to make for you. Your boards and Profile stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: AMOLED black
patches_modified.description: Paints the bottom bar pure black in dark mode, so it matches Pinterest's black pages on OLED screens. The comments sheet and a pin's menu can go black too, each with its own switch. Light mode stays as it is. Starts off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Disable analytics
patches_modified.description: Stops Pinterest from sending usage reports, crash reports and ad-tracking data to outside companies, and turns off Google's analytics inside the app. Good if you'd rather share less. On by default. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Disable update nag
patches_modified.description: Stops Pinterest's pop-ups asking you to update from the Play Store. You can still update Pinterest yourself. Good if the reminders get annoying. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Updates.

patches_modified.name: Download board
patches_modified.description: Adds Download board to a board's menu. It saves every pin Pinterest has loaded for that board, up to 500, and skips ones already in Download history, so you can keep a board without picking pins one at a time. Needs Download pins on too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Pin actions.

patches_modified.name: Download pins
patches_modified.description: Adds downloads for a pin, or for several pins you select in a grid. Saves the original image or the highest-quality video Pinterest supplies to your phone. When it saves an image, Pinterest's own Download image row is hidden. Downloads go to the Download folder. Turn on Save in Pinterest's folder to keep them in Pictures/100PINT/Pins with Pinterest's own saves, or use Pick a download folder to choose any folder inside Pictures, DCIM, Download or Documents. Starts off. Copy image puts an image pin's full-size picture on the clipboard, and Share image sends it through Android's share menu. Each has its own switch, also off. Save pins you download also saves a pin you download to your profile, and Download pins you save also downloads a pin you save. Those two start off as well. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Pin actions.

patches_modified.name: Filter feed
patches_modified.description: Lets you take video pins (photos and GIFs stay) and pins that mention words you mute out of your home feed, search, related pins and boards, and pins you've already saved and Pinterest's suggestion rows out of your home feed. Starts off. Set it up in HushPinterest settings > Feed.
patches_modified.previous_description: Lets you take video pins (photos and GIFs stay) and pins that mention words you mute out of your home feed, search, related pins and boards, and pins you've already saved out of your home feed. Starts off. Set it up in HushPinterest settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Filter pin menu
patches_modified.description: Lets you hide Add to collage, Remix collage, Search image and Promote pin in a pin's menu, each with its own switch. Download, share and copy link stay. Starts off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Fix push notifications
patches_modified.description: Lets the patched app sign up for push notifications. Google's Firebase service only signs Pinterest up when the request names Pinterest's original signature, so this sends that signature's fingerprint and changes nothing else in the request. On by default. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings > Notifications.

patches_modified.name: GmsCore support
patches_modified.description: Lets Google sign-in and push notifications go through microG-RE instead of Google Play services. Pick it only if microG-RE is on your phone. Without microG-RE, Google sign-in and push notifications stop working in the patched app. It brings Spoof signature for Google sign-in along. It isn't selected by default. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Hide AI-labeled pins
patches_modified.description: Removes pins that Pinterest labels as made or changed with AI from your home feed, search, related pins and boards. A second switch also takes unlabeled pins whose title or description calls them AI art, or that come from an AI image site. Other AI images still show. Both start off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide Assistant
patches_modified.description: Removes Pinterest's AI Assistant from search, boards and pins, so you don't get its buttons or its suggestion row. Regular search keeps working. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide ads
patches_modified.description: Removes promoted pins from your home feed, search, related pins and boards, and hides panels that only hold ads. Good for a cleaner feed. On by default. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide advertising ID
patches_modified.description: Pinterest sees an empty advertising ID with ad tracking limited, the same as if you deleted your advertising ID in Android. Pinterest also stops keeping its browser ID in Google's Block Store, so a reinstall doesn't bring the old one back. Good for keeping ads from following you. On by default. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Hide closeup buttons
patches_modified.description: Lets you hide the buttons on a pin you open, each with its own switch. That covers the back arrow and the visual search (lens) button that float over the picture, the like, comment, share and more buttons under it, the Remix button and the Visit site button. Another switch keeps the lens but drops its glow and the Search image label Pinterest puts on it for your first pins each day. Two more rows draw the red Save button smaller or paint it a color you pick. Your phone's back gesture still leaves the pin, and Search image in the pin menu still works. They all start off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide comments
patches_modified.description: Collapses the comments and comment previews under pins. It doesn't change who can comment on your pins. Good for a quieter pin page. A separate switch hides the suggested replies next to the comment box. Both start off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide header buttons
patches_modified.description: Hides the small icon buttons at the end of the top bar. Back buttons, text buttons and account controls stay. Good for a cleaner top bar. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide navigation buttons
patches_modified.description: Lets you hide the Create, Notifications and Search buttons in the bottom bar, each with its own switch. The Create and Notifications switches also cover those buttons at the top of Home. Home and Profile stay. Starts off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide save toasts

patches_added.description: Lets you hide rows you never use from a post's three-dot menu, such as Interested, Not interested or Cast, so you can't tap them by accident. Nothing is hidden until you pick. Choose them in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches_modified.name: Clean up Reels
patches_modified.description: Hides clutter on reels, such as the Follow button, comment previews, Remix and Use template buttons and Threads cards between reels, so more of the video shows, and can play each reel once instead of over and over, keep its original audio instead of a Meta AI dub, drop the search suggestions under the caption, over the comments and at the top of a profile's reels, or hide the like, comment and share counts, the Like, Comment, Repost, Share, Save or speaker button, or the line naming the reel's sound. It can also keep the Reels tab to accounts you follow, open a video you tap in the feed on its own, with no reels after it, do the same for a reel you open from a link or a chat, play a feed video again right there when you tap Watch again instead of opening Reels, play a video you tap in Saved in the video player instead of Reels, go on to the next reel in Saved instead of a suggested one, keep reels playing without stopping to ask "Are you still watching?", fill a tall screen with a reel or a full-screen video instead of leaving black bars around it, with a pinch to see one reel whole, take the UP NEXT bar off the bottom of a video you open from the feed, hide the Fullscreen button under a wide video, stop the "This is taking a while" message when a video is slow to load, and play whole reels in the feed's Reels row instead of the same second over and over, or keep the Comment button on reels with comments turned off so you can read them, and hide the one-tap Subscribe button some authors get instead of Follow, or Search and the button beside it at the top of a video you open and of the Reels tab, and show when a reel or video was posted. patches_modified.name: Hide video action buttons

patches_added.name: Allow landscape
patches_added.description: Lets Messenger turn sideways with your phone, for a wider keyboard and bigger photos and videos. It follows your phone's auto-rotate setting. Calls, the camera, payments and a few other screens stay upright. Restart Messenger after you change it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Android Auto messages
patches_added.description: Lets Android Auto read your Messenger messages out loud and send the replies you speak, through its own messaging screen. Android Auto only shows apps installed from the Play Store. Unknown sources in its developer settings opens that up on a desktop head unit, and a real car can still leave Messenger out. Playing a message aloud marks the chat read and shows Seen, even with Hide read receipts on. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Ask before a call
patches_added.description: Tapping an audio or video call button asks first, so a stray tap doesn't ring anyone. That covers a chat's top bar, business chats and the New message screen. Call starts it, Cancel doesn't. Calls coming in aren't affected. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Auto reply
patches_added.description: Answers messages with replies you write in HushMessenger settings, when they have words you pick or any message at all. Replies go out through Messenger's own notification reply, encrypted chats too, at most once every five minutes per chat. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Bigger chat preview
patches_added.description: Gives the chat more room in the preview you get when you press and hold a chat, and lets you scroll back through it there. The menu under it keeps a set height and scrolls when it has more items. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Blur behind menus
patches_added.description: Blurs the screen behind the menu you get when you press and hold a chat, and behind Messenger's other pop-up menus and sheets, like on an iPhone. Needs Android 12 or newer. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Bold and italic text
patches_added.description: Adds Bold and Italic to the menu that shows when you select words you typed. They're special Unicode letters, so they show on any phone, but screen readers may read them oddly. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Clone install under another package name
patches_added.description: Installs a second copy of Messenger beside the first, with its own app name. Push notifications may not reach the copy. Pick it in Morphe Manager's Expert mode. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_added.name: Custom launcher icon
patches_added.description: Makes Messenger's home screen icon white on black or black on white. Pick it and its style in Morphe Manager's Expert mode. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_added.name: Custom new-message sound
patches_added.description: Replaces Messenger's new-message sound with an .ogg, .mp3, .m4a or .wav file (1 MB or less) that you choose. Pick it in Morphe Manager's Expert mode. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_added.name: Customize message actions
patches_added.description: Lets you choose the order of the actions you get by holding a message, and hide the ones you don't use, separately for messages you sent and messages you got. The first ones show in the row under the message and the rest under More. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Fix videos in chat heads
patches_added.description: Draws videos in a chat head like the rest of the chat instead of on a separate layer, which some phones showed as a black box that stayed on screen after the chat head closed. Videos in the app itself are left as they are.

patches_added.name: Fix videos that won't send
patches_added.description: Messenger stops two kinds of video with "Unable to send". One is a video whose only sound is xHE-AAC, which Facebook and Instagram now use. The other is a Samsung screen recording whose recorder tag Messenger's media check rejects. Whether you share one into Messenger from another app or pick it in a chat, the sound is converted to regular AAC, or the tag is dropped, so it sends. The picture isn't touched. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Floating tab bar
patches_added.description: Switches the tab bar at the bottom to the floating style Messenger is trying out, which sits over your chats instead of below them. Messenger may keep its usual bar on some screens. Restart Messenger to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: GmsCore support
patches_added.description: Gets Messenger's push notifications through microG-RE instead of Google Play services. It also gives microG-RE the signature of Meta's own Messenger for the Google services that check one. Only for phones with microG-RE installed, since Messenger stops asking Google Play services. Install microG-RE before you open the patched app. Pick it in Morphe Manager's Expert mode. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_added.name: Hide Mark as read
patches_added.description: Hides Mark as read in the menu you get when you press and hold a chat in your chat list, so you can't mark a chat read by accident. Mark as unread stays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Hide Notifications tab
patches_added.description: Hides the Notifications tab in the bar at the bottom. Restart Messenger to see the tab go. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Hide People tab
patches_added.description: Hides the People tab in the bar at the bottom. Restart Messenger to see the tab go. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Hide Stories tab
patches_added.description: Hides the Stories tab in the bar at the bottom. Restart Messenger to see the tab go. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Hide Your story when sharing
patches_added.description: When you share a photo, video or link into Messenger from another app, your phone's share menu no longer offers Messenger's Your story, so it goes straight to Chats. The Send to list drops Your story too, so a tap on Add can't post it by mistake. Your chats and groups are still there. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Hide ad banners in business chats
patches_added.description: In a chat you started from a business's ad, hides the banner that shows that ad. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Hide call buttons
patches_added.description: Takes the audio and video call buttons out of a chat's top bar, business chats and the New message screen, so you can't tap one by accident. Calls still ring, and you can still join one that's going. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Hide chat menu items
patches_added.description: Hides the items you pick from the menu you get when you press and hold a chat in your chat list. Press and hold any chat once, and that menu's items show up under this switch for you to pick. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Hide chosen chats
patches_added.description: Adds Hide from chat list to the menu you get when you press and hold a chat. A hidden chat stays off your chat list when new messages come in, and search still finds it. Hiding stays on this phone, and you can unhide chats in HushMessenger settings. It doesn't stop notifications, so mute the chat in Messenger for that. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Hide pictures on the Blocked list
patches_added.description: Hides people's profile pictures on the list of people you've blocked, under Privacy and safety. Their names and Unblock stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Hide tab badges
patches_added.description: Hides the red dots and counts on the tabs at the bottom and on the Facebook button at the top. Turn on Keep for any you still want. Restart Messenger to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Hide the Instants button
patches_added.description: Hides the + button that slides in at the right edge of your chat list and the one under your chat heads. Both open Instants. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Hide the recent photo card
patches_added.description: Stops the card above the message box that offers to send the screenshot, photo or video you just took. You can still send it from the gallery. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Hide the tab bar while scrolling
patches_added.description: Slides the tab bar at the bottom out of the way as you scroll down your chats and brings it back when you scroll up. Restart Messenger to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Hold stories at the end
patches_added.description: Keeps a story on screen when it ends instead of moving on to the next one, so you go on with a tap or a swipe. Photos and videos both wait, and the last story stays open until you close it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Ignore the swipe up for disappearing messages
patches_added.description: Swiping up at the bottom of a chat no longer turns on disappearing messages, so a scroll can't set the timer by accident. You can still change it in the chat's settings. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Jump to the first message or a date
patches_added.description: Long press a chat's name at the top of the chat to jump to its first message or to a day you pick. Messenger loads a chat a page at a time, so it scrolls back with a count on screen until it gets there, and Cancel stops it. It can only go as far back as Messenger can load. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Keep a message log
patches_added.description: Saves each message when its notification arrives, so you can still read it if it's unsent, and marks the ones that were. Works in end-to-end encrypted chats too. Stays on your phone. A clock next to the new message button in Chats can open the log too, and so can a row in the menu you get when you press and hold a chat, which opens just that chat's messages. Log chats that don't notify, under it, adds muted and restricted chats without notifying you. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Keep chat pop-ups
patches_added.description: Messenger can turn off message pop-ups for good when it expects a chat head to show. This stops that and brings them back on a phone where it already happened, unless you lowered them yourself in Android's settings or picked Chat heads under Allow chat bubbles.

patches_added.name: Keep emoji search on emoji
patches_added.description: Typing while the emoji keyboard is open no longer jumps to sticker search. The keyboard stays on emoji. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Keep the search bar
patches_added.description: Brings back the search bar at the top of your chat list when Messenger has swapped it for a search icon. Restart Messenger after changing it. If Messenger never gave you the icon, nothing changes. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Keep unsent messages
patches_added.description: Keeps messages on screen after someone unsends them, in chats where it works. In end-to-end encrypted chats the message stays in its notification instead, since the chat itself can't keep it. Group chats aren't tested. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Live captions on calls
patches_added.description: Shows what the other people say during a call as captions over Messenger. Your phone makes them itself, and it can translate them into your language and read them aloud. It needs Android 13 or newer with speech recognition on the phone. While it's on, calls use Android's regular audio path instead of Messenger's own, and Messenger needs a restart after you change it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Mark as read button
patches_added.description: Puts Messenger's Mark as read icon in a chat's top bar while Hide read receipts is on. Opening the chat still sends nothing, and a tap on the icon sends Seen and marks the chat read. When the bar is full it takes the place of the chat details button (tapping the chat's name opens the same page), or of another button that isn't for calls when a chat doesn't have one, so the call buttons stay put. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Notify for restricted chats
patches_added.description: Chats with people you've restricted notify you like your other chats. A chat you've muted stays quiet. Restricted people still can't see when you're active or when you've read their messages. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Open your gallery app
patches_added.description: The gallery button in a chat opens your phone's own gallery app. One photo or video opens in Messenger's editor for that chat, ready to send. Pick several and Messenger's Send to sheet opens with all of them and that chat at the top. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Pin more chats
patches_added.description: Lets you pin chats past Messenger's limit and puts Pin back on chats that don't offer it. Pins past the limit stay on this phone, so they won't show on your other devices. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Preview chats on long press
patches_added.description: Pressing and holding a chat opens Messenger's own preview of it, with the chat's menu underneath, so you can peek at a chat without opening it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Put gallery picks in the chat
patches_added.description: With Open your gallery app on, what you pick goes into the chat's message box the way Messenger's own gallery puts it there, instead of the editor or the Send to sheet. Nothing goes out until you tap Send. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Quiet incoming calls
patches_added.description: Calls still come in, but Messenger doesn't ring, vibrate or pop the call up over your screen. The call waits in the notification shade with Answer and Decline. A call you miss still shows in the chat. Only chosen chats keeps this to the chats you pick, and every other call rings. If the Facebook app is on your phone, it can still ring for the same call. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Record calls
patches_added.description: Adds a Record button over Messenger during a call. The call goes into one sound file in Recordings/Messenger Calls on your phone (Music/Messenger Calls on Android 10 and 11). While it's on, calls use Android's regular audio path instead of Messenger's own, and Messenger needs a restart after you change it. Messenger doesn't tell the other people, and recording laws differ from place to place, so get everyone's OK first. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Restore old emoji drawer
patches_added.description: Turns off Meta's redesigned emoji keyboard, so you keep the earlier layout. Restart Messenger after changing it. If Meta never gave you the redesign, nothing changes. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Save button for voice messages
patches_added.description: Adds Save voice message to the menu you get by holding a voice message, for saving just that one. It goes in the same folder as Save voice messages you play, and that switch can stay off. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Save voice messages you play
patches_added.description: Each voice message you play is also saved to Recordings/Messenger (Music/Messenger on Android 10 and 11), so your file manager and other players can open it. Playing it again doesn't save another copy. Needs Android 10 or newer. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Search saved messages
patches_added.description: Adds a button to a chat's search results that searches the messages saved on this phone, for old chats Messenger's own search finds nothing in. It works in chats that aren't end-to-end encrypted, and it can only find what the phone has loaded. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Send Instants from your gallery
patches_added.description: Tapping the shutter in Instants opens your phone's gallery app instead of taking a photo. The photo you pick goes out as the Instant, cut to the camera's shape. Back out of the gallery and nothing is sent. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Send videos without re-encoding
patches_added.description: Sends a video as the original file instead of a recompressed copy, when Messenger allows it. Videos over 25 MB, edited videos and some formats are still compressed. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Show People tab
patches_added.description: Puts the People tab back in the bar at the bottom, right after Chats, on accounts where Messenger took it away. Restart Messenger to see the tab. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Special contacts
patches_added.description: Adds Track this person to the menu you get when you press and hold a chat with one person. HushMessenger then keeps a history of when they come online, go offline, type to you and change their name, from what Messenger already shows you. The history stays on this phone, and you can read it in HushMessenger settings. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Spoof package version
patches_added.description: Gives Messenger a high version number so the Play Store stops offering Meta's updates. Messenger may report it to Meta. Going back means uninstalling first, which erases its data. Pick it in Expert mode. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_added.name: Square profile pictures
patches_added.description: Shows profile pictures as squares instead of circles, or as rounded squares with Round the corners on. Restart Messenger after changing it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Stop ad attribution uploads
patches_added.description: Stops the job that reads your phone's advertising ID and sends it to Meta with your ad tracking setting. The ID itself doesn't change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Stop analytics uploads
patches_added.description: Stops the background services Messenger uses to upload usage statistics. It still records them on your phone, and they can upload after you turn this off. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Stop app list and device ID sharing
patches_added.description: Stops Messenger from going through the apps on your phone to find other Meta apps, and from asking them for the device ID Meta uses to link the apps on one phone. Messenger keeps the ID it already has. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Stop inbox and ad link logging
patches_added.description: Stops two reports Messenger logs. One says which part of your chat list was on screen, which Messenger files under inbox ads. The other says which ad brought you in when a link from an ad opens a chat. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Stop live connection logging
patches_added.description: Drops the health reports and push logging Messenger sends over its live connection (MQTT). Messenger sends most of its traffic another way, so there's often little for it to drop. Messages, calls and active status keep working. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Stop nearby scans
patches_added.description: Stops Messenger from reading the list of Wi-Fi networks around you, and hides the name and hardware address of the one you're connected to, the way Android does when Messenger can't see your location. Also stops the timer it can run while it's open to check your location and scan for Wi-Fi networks and Bluetooth devices. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Unlock app icons
patches_added.description: Lets you pick any icon in Messenger's App icon setting without a subscription. Messenger still decides whether that setting shows for your account. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Unlock app themes
patches_added.description: Lets you pick any theme in Messenger's Theme setting without a subscription, so light mode can get a color too. Messenger still decides which themes it offers your account. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Use the phone's camera app
patches_added.description: The camera button in a chat opens your phone's own camera app. The photo then opens in Messenger's editor, ready to send. Its Ask photo or video option records videos too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Use your own font
patches_added.description: Shows Messenger's text in your phone's font instead of Meta's, or in a .ttf or .otf file you pick in HushMessenger settings. Emoji don't change. Restart Messenger after changing it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Your own home header
patches_added.description: Puts words or a picture of your own at the top of the chat list in place of Messenger's wordmark. Type the words or pick the picture in HushMessenger settings. With neither, the wordmark stays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_removed.name: Hide inbox ads
patches_removed.description: Filters typed inbox ad items, in case Meta brings back the inbox ads it stopped selling in November 2025. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches_removed.name: Unsent message history
patches_removed.description: Saves a private local text snapshot when a verified receive or render route exposes it, then marks that local record when Messenger reports an unsend. Messenger's own unsend behavior is left unchanged. It also keeps up to 30 recent notification-text snapshots as a fallback; those fallback rows are not called unsent because Android notifications do not reliably expose Messenger message IDs. Messenger 580 variant 346013370 has a verified E2EE receive/revoke path; other E2EE builds, media attachments and group coverage are not yet verified. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches_modified.name: Allow chat bubbles
patches_modified.description: Lets you pick Stock, Chat heads or Android bubbles for floating chats. Needs Android 11 or newer. Chat heads also needs Messenger's own Chat heads switch, and Android bubbles need Messenger's bubbles allowed in Android's notification settings. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
patches_modified.previous_description: Offers Stock, Chat Heads and Native Bubbles on verified Messenger routes on Android 11 and newer. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches_modified.name: Allow screenshots
patches_modified.description: Lets you screenshot protected chat media, such as view-once photos and Quicksnap, and stops screenshot notices. It doesn't add replay or saving. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
patches_modified.previous_description: Lets you screenshot protected chat media, including view-once media and Quicksnap, and stops screenshot notices. This doesn't add replay or saving. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches_modified.name: Hide AI sticker tools
patches_modified.description: Hides the Generate and Generate AI sticker buttons, the AI sticker tab and AI sticker suggestions. Custom and music stickers in the Generate menu go with it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides the Generate AI sticker buttons, generated-sticker tab and AI sticker suggestions. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches_modified.name: Hide Chat Moments
patches_modified.description: Hides Chat Moments in the menu. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides the Chat Moments entry in the menu. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches_modified.name: Hide Facebook shortcuts
patches_modified.description: Hides Facebook buttons, profile and sharing shortcuts, and the Also from Meta and Subscriptions sections in the Menu tab. Handy if you only use Messenger. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides Facebook toolbar, profile and sharing shortcuts, and Also from Meta in the Menu tab. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches_modified.name: Hide Meta AI
patches_modified.description: Hides the Meta AI floating button, toolbar button, tab and menu entries, AI in search and in @ suggestions, and the offer to summarize a chat's unread messages. Restart Messenger to see the tab go. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides the floating button, toolbar button, Meta AI tab, menu entries and search AI. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches_modified.name: Hide People You May Know
patches_modified.description: Hides suggested people in chats, search and stories, and on the People and Notifications tabs, so you only see people you know. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides suggested people in chats, search and stories, and on the People and Notifications tabs. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches_modified.name: Hide Reels badge
patches_modified.description: Hides the Reels notification badge. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides the Reels notification badge. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches_modified.name: Hide avatar stickers
patches_modified.description: Hides the avatar tab in the sticker keyboard. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides the avatar tab in the sticker keyboard. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches_modified.name: Hide business reply suggestions
patches_modified.description: Hides suggested replies in conversations with businesses. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides suggested replies in business conversations. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches_modified.name: Hide business typing suggestions
patches_modified.description: Hides business suggestions that pop up as you type. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides business suggestions as you type. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches_modified.name: Hide chat promotions
patches_modified.description: Hides promotion banners inside conversations. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides Messenger quick-promotion banners inside conversations. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches_modified.name: Hide event prompts
patches_modified.description: Hides event promotion prompts inside chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides event quick-promotion prompts inside chats. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches_modified.name: Hide friend request cards
patches_modified.description: Hides friend request cards in your chat list so they stop taking up room. It doesn't accept or decline anyone. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides friend request cards inside the inbox. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches_modified.name: Hide growth prompts
patches_modified.description: Hides prompts to add more people, the tip sheets in notes (like Make my notes public), and the Share your own story card after someone else's stories. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides the inbox's add-more-people promotion unit. Also hides the tip sheets in notes, like Make my notes public, and the Share your own story card after someone else's stories. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches_modified.name: Hide inbox promotions
patches_modified.description: Hides promotion banners in your chat list. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides Messenger quick-promotion banners in the chat list. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches_modified.name: Hide inbox tabs
patches_modified.description: Hides the All, Unread and Groups tabs above your chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides the Home and Channels subtabs. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches_modified.name: Hide joined community chats
patches_modified.description: Hides the community chats you joined from your main chat list. Search and community folders still show them. Messages and unread counts don't change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides joined community-chat rows from the main inbox on its next render. Keeps Search, community folders, delivery and unread counts unchanged. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches_modified.name: Hide read receipts
patches_modified.description: Opening a chat no longer tells people you read their message, and the chat stays unread on this phone. Marking it read yourself or replying in it marks it read and shows Seen, like Messenger does. Group chats aren't tested. Messenger's own Read receipts setting under Privacy & safety marks chats read without showing Seen. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
patches_modified.previous_description: Stops sending read receipts. Opened encrypted chats can stay unread on this phone. Replying or switching this off may notify the sender. Group coverage isn't verified. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches_modified.name: Hide stories and notes
patches_modified.description: Hides the row of stories and notes above your chats, and the story rings around profile pictures. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides the horizontal tray above chats. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches_modified.name: Hide typing indicator
patches_modified.description: Stops Messenger from showing others when you're typing, even in end-to-end encrypted chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
patches_modified.previous_description: Suppresses your outgoing active-typing signal, including in end-to-end encrypted chats. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches_modified.name: Install beside Meta apps
patches_modified.description: Lets your patched Messenger install next to Facebook and other Meta apps. Without it, the apps can clash over shared permissions and the install can stop at a blank screen. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
patches_modified.previous_description: Renames two shared permissions so a re-signed Messenger can install beside Meta apps. Checked 580 builds only. Earlier clean installs stopped at a blank first-run screen.

patches_modified.name: Material You theme
patches_modified.description: Colors Messenger's dark mode with your wallpaper colors on Android 12 and newer, and a fixed blue on Android 11. Turn on dark mode in Messenger first. Light mode keeps its colors unless you turn on Light mode accent. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
patches_modified.previous_description: Gives Messenger's dark mode the colors of your wallpaper on Android 12 and newer, and a fixed blue palette on Android 11. Light mode stays as it is. Turn on dark mode in Messenger first.

patches_modified.name: Open settings from menu
patches_modified.description: Adds a HushMessenger entry to Messenger's Menu tab and side menu, and makes a long press on the Messenger logo at the top of Chats or on the Menu tab's title open these settings too. Works as soon as you patch it in. The settings App tab can turn off each way in, as long as one stays on.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds a HushMessenger entry to the Menu tab and side menu. Always on.

patches_modified.name: Open web links externally
patches_modified.description: Opens web links (http and https) in your default browser instead of inside Messenger. Other link types work as before. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
patches_modified.previous_description: Uses Messenger's external-browser branch for HTTP and HTTPS links. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches_modified.name: Restore screens on re-signed builds
patches_modified.description: Patching and signing Messenger yourself can break some of its screens. This makes Messenger's signature check pass again, including for a Facebook you patched with the same key, and lets Threads and Instagram video links open in a Threads or Instagram you patched yourself. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
patches_modified.previous_description: Answers Messenger's own signer lookup, and a Facebook signed with your key calling Messenger, with the original Meta certificate. Always on.

patches_modified.name: Save any story
patches_modified.description: Adds Save to the More options menu on other people's stories, so you can keep their photo or video on your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds Save to the More options menu on other people's stories. The photo or video goes to your phone the same way Messenger saves your own. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches_modified.name: Send photos at original quality
patches_modified.description: With HD on, sends a JPEG photo at its full size instead of Messenger's smaller copy, so it stays sharp. Location is still removed. Photos over 20 MB are still made smaller. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
patches_modified.previous_description: With HD on, sends a JPEG photo's own image data instead of a re-encoded copy, without its metadata except the rotation tag. Videos and photos over 20 MB are still compressed. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches_modified.name: Slide chats in and out
patches_modified.description: Slides a chat in from the side when you open it and back out when you go back. Chat heads and bubbles keep their own animations. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
patches_modified.previous_description: Slides a chat in from the side when you open it and back out when you go back, while the screen underneath holds still. Chat heads and bubbles keep their own animations. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches_modified.name: Use system emoji
patches_modified.description: Shows emoji in your phone's own style instead of Messenger's. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
patches_modified.previous_description: Renders emoji with the phone's own font instead of Messenger's. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches_modified.name: View stories anonymously
patches_modified.description: Opens other people's stories without adding you to their viewer list. Messenger still marks them as seen on your side. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
patches_modified.previous_description: Opens other people's stories without adding you to their viewer list. Stories you open this way are marked as seen on your side. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches_modified.name: AMOLED Black
patches_modified.description: Paints the app's own dark theme pure black (#000000) instead of dark grey, for OLED screens. Native UI only: the games themselves are WebViews with their own web CSS and stay dark grey.

patches_modified.name: Unlock Subscription
patches_modified.description: Reports the account as an active Games subscriber, unlocking subscriber-only archives and bonus puzzles. Client side only; the backend may still refuse some content.

patches_modified.name: Enable Premium
patches_modified.description: Enables app features locked behind the subscription paywall.

patches_modified.name: Enable Prime
patches_modified.description: Unlocks Nova Launcher Prime by starting the app in the prime state and reporting an active subscription, so the settings and features gated on Prime are available.

patches_modified.name: Enable Cloud Premium
patches_modified.description: Reports the Sleep Cloud subscription as active. Client side only; the backend may still refuse.

patches_modified.name: Enable Premium
patches_modified.description: Unlocks Sleep as Android Premium. Tap Wait I already Paid when Prompted

patches_added.name: Firma original en PackageManager (V29)
patches_added.description: La proteccion nativa lee la firma del APK via PackageManager y el servidor valida proofs calculados con la firma ORIGINAL. Este patch instala un proxy del PackageManager que devuelve la firma original, para que la libreria nativa genere proofs validos y el catalogo cargue con el APK re-firmado. Debe usarse sin eliminar las librerias nativas.

patches_modified.name: Compatibilidad con integridad nativa (V29)
patches_modified.description: La app firma sus peticiones al catalogo con libprotection.so, que verifica la firma del APK. Al re-firmar con Morphe ese chequeo falla y el gate queda en false: la app degrada sus rutas y el catalogo puede quedarse cargando. Este patch neutraliza el chequeo (la comparacion siempre da valida) conservando la carga de la lib nativa y el manejo de errores original. Requiere no eliminar las librerias nativas del APK.
patches_modified.previous_description: La app firma sus peticiones al catalogo con libprotection.so, que verifica la firma del APK. Al re-firmar con Morphe ese gate queda en false. Este patch carga la lib nativa y fuerza el gate a true sin ejecutar el chequeo, para que el app use las rutas de proteccion normales. Pruebalo solo si la app se cierra al arrancar o el catalogo no carga con los demas patches.

patches_modified.name: Always show publish date
