It can also show the exact time, dates and lengths on profile grids, sort the videos a grid has loaded, start your Liked grid at a year or month you pick, or add a drag handle and jump buttons to long grids. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Fit the video to the screen
patches_modified.description: Shows the whole video instead of cutting off its sides on folding phones, squarer screens and split screen, and fits photo slideshows whole on squarer screens. Two more switches cover the whole screen instead, one by cropping the video and one by stretching it. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.
patches_modified.previous_description: Shows the whole video instead of cutting off its sides on folding phones, squarer screens and split screen, and fits photo slideshows whole on squarer screens. A second switch does the opposite and fills the screen. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Hide inbox items
patches_modified.description: Lets you hide Inbox rows you don't use, like message requests, TikTok Shop, the stories row and the On this day memory in it, plus call buttons and suggested replies in chats. Each has its own switch. Also offers search in loaded Activity notifications and TikTok's Main, Requests, Unread and Starred tabs on any account, a way to rebuild message search, room to pin more than 5 chats and the time under each chat message. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.
patches_modified.previous_description: Lets you hide Inbox rows you don't use, like message requests, TikTok Shop, the stories row and the On this day memory in it, plus call buttons and suggested replies in chats. Each has its own switch. Also offers search in loaded Activity notifications and TikTok's Main, Requests, Unread and Starred tabs on any account, a way to rebuild message search and room to pin more than 5 chats. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Hide video overlays
patches_modified.description: Lets you hide clutter over videos, like the caption, the music line, buttons on the right, surveys and location labels, so you see more of the video. It can also make the music disc spin again or keep it still. Each has its own switch. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Settings
patches_modified.description: Adds the Hushfeed settings page to TikTok, at the top of Settings and privacy. Pressing and holding For You at the top of the feed opens it too. That's where you turn Hushfeed's features on and off, and pick any of TikTok's own Settings and privacy rows to hide. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds the Hushfeed settings page to TikTok, at the top of Settings and privacy. Pressing and holding For You at the top of the feed opens it too. That's where you turn Hushfeed's features on and off. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Show author region
patches_modified.description: Shows the country a video was posted from next to the creator's name. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: LIVE controls
patches_modified.description: Stops a LIVE in the feed from opening by itself after a countdown. It can show a LIVE's exact viewer count instead of a rounded one, offer a quality choice and clear screen in more LIVE rooms, and keep your quality pick after TikTok restarts. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback. It also keeps a LIVE in the feed from showing the Service+ row of the LIVE before it (or hides that row altogether), can hide the AI summary on LIVE previews, and can add a Record button to a LIVE room that saves what you watch from when you tap it.
patches_modified.previous_description: Stops a LIVE in the feed from opening by itself after a countdown. It can show a LIVE's exact viewer count instead of a rounded one, offer a quality choice and clear screen in more LIVE rooms, and keep your quality pick after TikTok restarts. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback. It also keeps a LIVE in the feed from showing the Service+ row of the LIVE before it (or hides that row altogether), and can add a Record button to a LIVE room that saves what you watch from when you tap it.

patches_modified.name: Bypass native integrity checks
patches_modified.description: Neutralizes libunnamed_raw.so's five ARM64 self-integrity gates (BTI/PAC-safe) and wraps the session-opening plus every other native-calling bridge wrapper in a real JVM try/catch that fails open on integrity errors. Required together with 'Allow re-signed/sideloaded installs'.
patches_modified.previous_description: libunnamed_raw.so JNI-throws 'app integrity check failed' on re-signed builds, killing camera session start (preview) - observed via diagnostic crash log. This patch calls the session-opening wrapper inside a real JVM try/catch (extension) and substitutes a well-formed session result on failure. Required together with 'Allow re-signed/sideloaded installs'.

patches_modified.name: Unlock Pro features
patches_modified.description: Unlocks all Mereframe Pro features locally across both the Kotlin entitlement resolver (Qu.k/m) and the native license/session verifier (Bf1c089 + libunnamed_raw.so), eliminating paywall popups and capture/editor SecurityException crashes. Pair with 'Allow re-signed/sideloaded installs' and 'Bypass native integrity checks'.
patches_modified.previous_description: Returns every registered feature from the entitlement accessor (Qu.k) so all Pro gates resolve unlocked. LOCAL client-side effect only. WARNING (kept off by default): on at least one device (realme/Android 16) enabling the single registered Pro feature crashes capture - the Pro pipeline path is gated by this flag and we cannot verify its safety side. Enable only if you specifically want the Pro toolset; the app works fully (RAW capture incl.) with just 'Allow re-signed installs'.

patches_added.name: Disable screenshot detection
patches_added.description: Prevents the app from detecting screenshots and displaying the share popup on Android 14+.

patches_modified.name: Amazon: Stop feed video autoplay
patches_modified.description:
Stops Amazon's home-feed native video units (live promotional videos,
review carousels, sponsored reels) from starting on their own, using
the same setPlayWhenReady(true) → false heuristic as the universal
'Disable video autoplay (ExoPlayer/Media3)' patch.

Covers native ExoPlayer/Media3 players only — NOT the in-app WebView
pages (use the default-on 'Disable video autoplay' patch for those),
and NOT WebView CSS-injected ad blocks (use 'Remove ads'). Heuristic:
reflection or obfuscated player setup is not covered. Can stop playback
entirely in apps whose only play path is a flipped literal call — turn
it off if videos never start. Unverified on device.

patches_modified.name: Dark mode
patches_modified.description: Force dark mode for Amazon Shopping.

patches_modified.name: Disable search suggestions tracking
patches_modified.description: Prevents search keypress and focus events from being sent with suggestion requests.

patches_modified.name: Disable video autoplay
patches_modified.description: Prevents videos from autoplaying in Amazon's in-app WebView pages.

patches_modified.name: Fix Amazon manifest conflicts
patches_modified.description: Updates shared Amazon permissions so other Amazon apps can coexist.

patches_modified.name: Hide Rufus tab
patches_modified.description: Removes the Rufus AI assistant tab from Amazon's bottom navigation bar.

patches_modified.name: Open links in browser
patches_modified.description: Opens non-Amazon URLs in the default browser instead of the in-app WebView.

patches_modified.name: Price history charts
patches_modified.description: Injects Keepa and CamelCamelCamel price history charts on Amazon product pages.

patches_modified.name: Remove ads
patches_modified.description: Hides sponsored and ad content in Amazon Shopping via CSS injection.

patches_added.name: Fix Spotify login
patches_added.description: Makes Add to Spotify work in the patched app. The Spotify app turns down a patched TikTok, so you sign in on Spotify's own page instead. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: AMOLED dark theme
patches_modified.description: Makes TikTok's dark mode backgrounds pure black, or a dark color you pick in this patch's options. Black lets OLED screens switch those pixels off. Light mode doesn't change. The AMOLED dark mode switch in Adrmodtt settings > App starts on, and turning it off brings TikTok's own dark grays back.

patches_modified.name: Accent color
patches_modified.description: Swaps the red of TikTok's main buttons and red text for blue, green, purple, orange, teal or a color code you type in this patch's options, or for the color of the phone's wallpaper theme on Android 12 and up. Unread dots and counts change with it. Warnings stay red, and so can icons with the red drawn in. The feed's like heart and save bookmark can take colors of their own. It's built in while patching, so only patching again without it undoes it.

patches_modified.name: Account cleanup
patches_modified.description: Adds Remove all reposts, Remove all likes and Clear Favorites to Adrmodtt settings > Privacy. Each one takes items off your account one at a time through TikTok's own requests, with a pause between them, and stops on the first error.

patches_modified.name: Advanced downloads
patches_modified.description: Adds more ways to save: pick the video quality, save full-size photos, the sound on its own or a photo post as one video, hold a profile picture or story to save it, save a story or a video's cover from the share sheet, put a save button on the video, and pick videos on a profile grid to save in one run. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Downloads.

patches_modified.name: Allow Duet and Stitch
patches_modified.description: Shows the Duet and Stitch buttons on videos whose creator turned them off, so you can still make one, and Add to Story in the share sheet and on stories when the creator turned off content reuse. TikTok may still refuse some videos or the upload. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Share sheet.

patches_modified.name: Allow screenshots and Circle to Search
patches_modified.description: Lets screenshots, screen recordings and Circle to Search work on TikTok screens that would otherwise come out black. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > App, then restart TikTok.

patches_modified.name: Always show publish date
patches_modified.description: Shows the date a video was posted next to the creator's name, so you can tell how old it is. It can also show the exact time, dates and lengths on profile grids, sort the videos a grid has loaded, start your Liked grid at a year or month you pick, or add a drag handle and jump buttons to long grids. On by default. Turn it off in Adrmodtt settings > Feed screen.
patches_modified.previous_description: Shows the date a video was posted next to the creator's name, so you can tell how old it is. It can also show the exact time, dates and lengths on profile grids, or sort the videos a grid has loaded. On by default. Turn it off in Adrmodtt settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Always upload in HD
patches_modified.description: Posts every video you upload in HD, as if you'd turned on TikTok's own HD upload setting each time. Videos TikTok doesn't count as high quality post as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > App.

patches_modified.name: App lock
patches_modified.description: Asks for your fingerprint, face or PIN before TikTok opens, and again when you come back after a time you pick, so nobody else can open it on your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Automatic video advance
patches_modified.description: Moves on to the next video by itself when one ends, so you can watch hands-free. It can also turn on TikTok's auto scroll in search results. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Block P2P video relay
patches_modified.description: Removes the files TikTok uses to pass videos on to other viewers through your phone's internet connection. The app gets about 4.5 MB smaller. It's built in while patching, so only patching again without it brings them back.

patches_modified.name: Block author button
patches_modified.description: Adds buttons on videos to block the creator, hide them only on your phone, or block the sound, so you can get rid of what you don't want in one tap. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Block contact list access
patches_modified.description: Gives TikTok an empty contact list when it tries to read your phone's contacts, so it can't use them to suggest friends. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Block installed app scanning
patches_modified.description: Gives TikTok an empty list when it asks which apps are on your phone, so it learns less about you. Opening another app from TikTok still works. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Block popups
patches_modified.description: Lets you stop TikTok's popups, like friend suggestions and offers. Each one joins a checklist after it first appears, and once ticked it won't come back. Sign-in, age and verification screens are never blocked. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Block suggested video notifications
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok's "Videos you might like" notifications about popular videos it picked for you. Messages, comments, likes and posts from people you follow still come through. On by default. Turn it off in Adrmodtt settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Camera and microphone indicator
patches_modified.description: Shows a small mark in the top corner while TikTok is using the camera or microphone, so you always know when it is. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Change app name
patches_modified.description: Shows a name you choose under the app icon, so the patched TikTok is easy to tell apart from another copy. Type the name in this patch's options. Inside the app it still says TikTok.

patches_modified.name: Comment publish diagnostics
patches_modified.description: Adds a note to Adrmodtt's diagnostic report about how far a comment got when it fails to post, which helps track down comments that vanish without an error. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Comment send fix
patches_modified.description: Fixes comments that TikTok sometimes drops without any message, so the comment you send actually posts. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Comment sort controls
patches_modified.description: Shows TikTok's full comment sort menu on every video, with hot, newest, media and creator options, even when your account only got a cut-down version. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Comment tools
patches_modified.description: Hides comments with words you pick or from accounts you pick, and adds a search box for a video's comments. It can also make links tappable and show poll results before you vote. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Confirm feed interactions
patches_modified.description: Asks for a second tap before Follow, a like, or a quick repost goes through, so a stray tap doesn't count. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Copy bio and IDs
patches_modified.description: Lets you long-press a bio to copy it, makes the @names in a bio open those profiles on a tap, and adds share sheet buttons that copy a display name, username, user ID or video ID. On a profile card inside a LIVE room, long-press the bio or the name to copy it, long-press the username for the user ID, or tap the copy mark by the username. On by default. Turn it off in Adrmodtt settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Copy comments without username
patches_modified.description: When you copy a comment, you get just its text, without the username in front. On by default. Turn it off in Adrmodtt settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Create stickers
patches_modified.description: Adds a Create button to the Saved page of the comment sticker panel. Pick a photo and it turns into one of your saved stickers. Make sticker in a video's share sheet opens TikTok's sticker editor for any video, or uses its cover when the editor can't open. Profiles that have stickers keep their Stickers tab, and it opens their sticker sets. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds a Create button to the Saved page of the comment sticker panel. Pick a photo and it turns into one of your saved stickers. Make sticker in a video's share sheet does the same with its cover. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Custom launcher icon
patches_modified.description: Gives TikTok's home screen icon a themed version that takes your wallpaper's color on Android 13 and up. The options can also make it black, plain, Material You, any background color or your own picture, and put Adrmodtt's H in the status bar. Only patching again without it puts the old icons back.

patches_modified.name: Custom offline videos limit
patches_modified.description: Lets you pick how many videos TikTok saves for watching offline, from 1 to 10,000, and keep them until you delete them. Handy when you're often without internet. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Downloads.

patches_modified.name: Device privacy guard
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok reading what you copied and gives it a blank advertising ID. Can also hide a VPN connection and root status with details about root tools, and give TikTok a new device identity. Each switch starts off in Adrmodtt settings > Privacy. Changing Hide root needs a restart.

patches_modified.name: Diagnostic tools
patches_modified.description: Adds logs and reports you can save or share when something goes wrong, so a problem is easier to report and fix. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Diagnostics.

patches_modified.name: Disable login requirement
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok from forcing you to sign in before you can keep browsing. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Disable screen capture detection
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok from noticing and reacting when you take a screenshot or record the screen. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Disable telemetry
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok sending usage statistics and crash reports to TikTok and the tracking services it uses, so less of what you do in the app leaves your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Disable the long press quick share
patches_modified.description: Stops a long press on Share from opening TikTok's quick share, so you don't send a video by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Disable the long press repost
patches_modified.description: Stops a long press on Like from opening TikTok's repost option, so you don't repost by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Double-tap controls
patches_modified.description: Lets a double tap on a video do nothing, open its comments, copy the link, save the sound or the frame on screen, speed the video up, or set a sleep timer instead of liking it, so you don't like videos by accident. Each corner of the video can get its own action too. Starts off. Pick an action in Adrmodtt settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Downloads
patches_modified.description: Saves videos and photos without TikTok's watermark, even when the creator turned downloads off. You can also choose the folders and file names. On by default. Turn it off in Adrmodtt settings > Downloads.

patches_modified.name: Drop the animated image cache
patches_modified.description: Lets you make TikTok decode animated stickers and GIFs one frame at a time as they play, instead of a few frames ahead, so they use a little less memory. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Enable voice comments
patches_modified.description: Lets you turn on TikTok's voice comments, so you can record and post a spoken comment, for accounts that don't have them yet. It hasn't been tried on a real account, so it may not work. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Expand activity list
patches_modified.description: Shows the whole Activity and New followers lists in the Inbox, so you don't have to tap View all. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Feature Gate Lab
patches_modified.description: Adds an advanced page that lists the hidden settings TikTok uses to test features and lets you change them. It's for people who like to experiment. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Diagnostics.

patches_modified.name: Feature Gate Recorder
patches_modified.description: Records which hidden TikTok settings the app reads while you use it, and which ones changed. It's a research tool and changes nothing in TikTok. Start a recording in Adrmodtt settings > Diagnostics.

patches_modified.name: Feed filter
patches_modified.description: Hides ads in the feed, and lets you hide other things you don't want to see, like LIVEs, Shop posts, AI videos or videos with words, creators or sounds you pick. Hiding ads is on by default. Everything else starts off in Adrmodtt settings > Feed filter.

patches_modified.name: Feed tab navigation
patches_modified.description: Lets you hide feed and bottom tabs you don't use, put Discover in the bottom bar and Friends in the top tabs, rename the bottom tabs, pick the bottom bar's icons and height, choose the tab TikTok opens on, stop For You reloading when you tap Home and hold Profile to open your Watch history. Starts off, except holding Home to open Adrmodtt settings. Find it in Adrmodtt settings > Feed tabs.
patches_modified.previous_description: Lets you hide feed and bottom tabs you don't use, put Discover in the bottom bar, rename the bottom tabs, choose the tab TikTok opens on, stop For You reloading when you tap Home and hold Profile to open your Watch history. Starts off, except holding Home to open Adrmodtt settings. Find it in Adrmodtt settings > Feed tabs.

patches_modified.name: Feed text sizes
patches_modified.description: Lets you make video descriptions, creator names and post dates bigger or smaller, or give them a color and a backdrop, so they're easier to read. Starts off. Pick them in Adrmodtt settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Fit the video to the screen
patches_modified.description: Shows the whole video instead of cutting off its sides on folding phones, squarer screens and split screen, and fits photo slideshows whole on squarer screens. A second switch does the opposite and fills the screen. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Fix Google login
patches_modified.description: Makes Sign in with Google work in the patched app, where it would otherwise fail. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Foldable split comment view
patches_modified.description: On a folding phone or tablet, shows comments beside the video instead of over it when the screen is wide enough. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Follow diagnostics
patches_modified.description: Tells you when TikTok quietly turned down a follow, and why, since the app shows it as if it worked. With diagnostic logging on, the details go in the report too. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Freeze TikTok's experiments
patches_modified.description: Lets you keep the settings TikTok's servers sent it so far. TikTok tests new layouts and features on people by sending new ones all the time, and with this on it ignores them. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Ghost mode
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok telling people you viewed their story or profile, or that you're typing. What TikTok already recorded stays. Each of the three has its own switch under it, and a separate one hides your online status. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Hide CAPTCHA popups
patches_modified.description: Skips the puzzle TikTok shows while you're just browsing. A puzzle right after you like, follow, comment or repost still shows, and so do sign-in, SMS and two-step checks. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Feed screen, then restart TikTok.

patches_modified.name: Hide Play Store update offer
patches_modified.description: Stops the Play Store offering to swap the patched TikTok for the store version. The catch: a build with a lower version number won't install over it, and uninstalling to go back can erase TikTok's data on your phone.

patches_modified.name: Hide already seen videos
patches_modified.description: Remembers the videos you've watched and hides them when the feed sends them again, so you only see new ones. It can also keep a watch history you can search and reopen videos from. Both stay on your phone. Starts off. Turn them on in Adrmodtt settings > Feed filter.

patches_modified.name: Hide comment popup ads
patches_modified.description: Stops the brand animation that pops up over the comments when someone types a word or emoji an advertiser paid for. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Hide comment typing suggestions
patches_modified.description: Hides the emoji and sticker suggestions that pop up above the comment box while you type. The emoji and sticker buttons still work. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed LIVE button
patches_modified.description: Removes the LIVE button and the side menu button from the top left of the feed, for a cleaner screen, and can stop a right swipe on For You from opening the side menu. Each has its own switch, and all start off. Turn them on in Adrmodtt settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed follow button
patches_modified.description: Removes the + follow button under creators' pictures on the feed, so you don't follow someone by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed save button
patches_modified.description: Removes the save button from the right side of the feed, for a cleaner screen. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed search button
patches_modified.description: Removes the search button from the top right of the feed and the one over the video while comments are open. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Hide floating promotions
patches_modified.description: Hides the floating promotion badges, coins and timers on the feed, and can hide the rewards button on your profile. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Feed screen, and App for the rewards button.

patches_modified.name: Hide inbox items
patches_modified.description: Lets you hide Inbox rows you don't use, like message requests, TikTok Shop, the stories row and the On this day memory in it, plus call buttons and suggested replies in chats. Each has its own switch. Also offers search in loaded Activity notifications and TikTok's Main, Requests, Unread and Starred tabs on any account, a way to rebuild message search and room to pin more than 5 chats. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Inbox.
patches_modified.previous_description: Lets you hide Inbox rows you don't use, like message requests, TikTok Shop, the stories row and the On this day memory in it, plus call buttons and suggested replies in chats. Each has its own switch. Also offers search in loaded Activity notifications and TikTok's Main, Requests, Unread and Starred tabs on any account, and a way to rebuild message search. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Hide inbox stories
patches_modified.description: Hides the row of stories at the top of the Inbox. It uses the same switch as Hide inbox items. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Hide profile shortcuts
patches_modified.description: Hides the shortcuts you pick from the row under a profile's bio, like TikTok Studio or Your orders, and the profile tabs you pick, like Reposts or Liked videos. It can hide the Thoughts bubble, and Balance and the TikTok Minis icons in your profile's menu. It can also turn Thoughts on for accounts TikTok left out. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > App, then restart TikTok.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides the shortcuts you pick from the row under a profile's bio, like TikTok Studio or Your orders, and can hide the Thoughts bubble, and Balance and the TikTok Minis icons in your profile's menu. It can also turn Thoughts on for accounts TikTok left out. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > App, then restart TikTok.

patches_modified.name: Hide read receipts
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok telling people you've read their messages. Your own unread badges still clear as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Hide search suggestions
patches_modified.description: Hides the searches TikTok suggests before you type, and can hide the search rewards banner. Your own search history stays. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested accounts
patches_modified.description: Hides TikTok's People you may like suggestions in the Inbox, on profiles, on the Friends tab and in the feed. It uses the same switch as Hide inbox items. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Hide the launcher shortcuts
patches_modified.description: Empties the menu that pops up when you press and hold TikTok's icon on your home screen. Tapping the icon still opens the app. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Hide the risk control CAPTCHA
patches_modified.description: Lets Hide CAPTCHA popups also skip the puzzle TikTok's account safety check raises while you're just browsing. SMS and two-step checks always show. It sits on TikTok's account checks, which is why it isn't picked for you.

patches_modified.name: Hide video overlays
patches_modified.description: Lets you hide clutter over videos, like the caption, the music line, buttons on the right, surveys and location labels, so you see more of the video. It can also make the music disc spin again or keep it still. Each has its own switch. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Hold-and-slide 2x lock
patches_modified.description: Turns on TikTok's own gesture where you hold a video, slide down and let go to keep it playing fast without holding. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: In-app browser privacy guard
patches_modified.description: Stops websites you open in TikTok's built-in browser from reaching into the TikTok app. TikTok's own pages, like Watch history and checkout, keep working. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Keep a streak going
patches_modified.description: Sends a daily message you choose to people you pick, at a time you set, so your message streaks keep going on days you don't open TikTok. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Keep playing in the background
patches_modified.description: Keeps the video playing when you leave TikTok or turn the screen off, with a notification to pause it. It can also start the video over when it ends. Handy for music and talks. If you only want it on some videos, a second switch adds TikTok's own row to the long-press menu. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Playback, then restart TikTok.

patches_modified.name: Keep pulled sounds
patches_modified.description: Plays the sound on videos TikTok muted for copyright or because of where you live. TikTok may still say the sound isn't available. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Keep recent stickers
patches_modified.description: Adds Recently used above Saved in the comment sticker panel, with the last stickers you sent, and keeps it when you close and reopen the app. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Keep the Favorites tab
patches_modified.description: Keeps the Favorites tab and your saved videos on your profile when TikTok tries out a version of the app that hides them, and makes the collections popup you get by holding the Favorites button dark when TikTok is. Both are on by default. Turn them off in Adrmodtt settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Keep the app language
patches_modified.description: Lets you keep the language you picked in TikTok's own settings. When TikTok starts and decides the phone's language changed, it drops that pick and follows the phone, which can leave it in the wrong language after a reboot. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Keep the next videos in full screen
patches_modified.description: From most pages, TikTok's full screen view opens with only the video you were on, so there's nothing to swipe to and it can't move on by itself. This brings the videos after it along. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Keep the screen's brightness in the camera
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok from turning your screen brighter while you film, edit or post a video. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Keep the screen's refresh rate
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok slowing your screen down to the video's frame rate, so scrolling stays smooth on 90 or 120 Hz phones. TikTok doesn't ask on every phone, and where it doesn't, this changes nothing. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Keep unsent messages
patches_modified.description: Keeps a message in your chat when the other person unsends it, instead of removing it, and can mark it as unsent. A button removes the kept messages. Messages you unsend yourself are still removed. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: LIVE controls
patches_modified.description: Stops a LIVE in the feed from opening by itself after a countdown. It can show a LIVE's exact viewer count instead of a rounded one, offer a quality choice and clear screen in more LIVE rooms, and keep your quality pick after TikTok restarts. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Playback. It also keeps a LIVE in the feed from showing the Service+ row of the LIVE before it (or hides that row altogether), and can add a Record button to a LIVE room that saves what you watch from when you tap it.

patches_modified.name: Lift text length limits
patches_modified.description: Lets you write longer comments, repost notes and bios than the app normally allows. TikTok can still refuse one that's too long. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Limit background traffic
patches_modified.description: Lets you stop TikTok loading upcoming videos ahead of time, which uses less data in the background, but videos may take a moment longer to start. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Load all saved stickers
patches_modified.description: Loads every sticker you saved in one go when you open the sticker panel, instead of the first 100. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Location access governor
patches_modified.description: Gives TikTok no location when it asks, so it can't see where you are from your phone's location services. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Long-press controls
patches_modified.description: Lets a long press on a video like it, open the comments, copy the link, save the sound or the frame on screen, or set a sleep timer, and can give a creator's videos For You's full long-press menu. Starts off. Pick an action in Adrmodtt settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Look like the store app
patches_modified.description: Makes the patched app answer TikTok's checks as if it came from the Play Store, which can help when follows or likes undo themselves. TikTok has other checks, so it may not be enough. On once picked. Turn it off in Adrmodtt settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Mute feed videos
patches_modified.description: Mutes feed videos without changing your phone's volume, so music from another app keeps playing. You can also add a mute button on videos, or keep the sound and let other apps play until a video starts and after you leave it. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Network proxy
patches_modified.description: Sends TikTok's feed, search and comments through a proxy server you set up. Videos and LIVEs still load directly, and so do Adrmodtt's own saves and short-link lookups. HTTP and SOCKS5 both work, with or without a password. Other apps aren't affected. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Region, then restart TikTok.

patches_modified.name: Network request report
patches_modified.description: Counts the requests TikTok sends to its servers and adds the totals to the diagnostic report. It changes nothing in TikTok, but it has no switch and most people don't need it.

patches_modified.name: Not interested button
patches_modified.description: Adds a button on videos that tells TikTok you're not interested in one tap, so it can show you fewer like it. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Notification controls
patches_modified.description: Lets you turn off new follower notifications and streak reminders, which TikTok has no switch for, or turn off TikTok's notifications altogether. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Open external links directly
patches_modified.description: Opens website links from profiles and stories in your phone's own browser instead of TikTok's built-in one. On by default. Turn it off in Adrmodtt settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Open the comments at full height
patches_modified.description: Opens the comment sheet at the full height of the screen instead of part way up. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Picture-in-picture
patches_modified.description: Keeps the video playing in a small window when you leave TikTok, so you can keep watching while you use other apps. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Play SDR instead of HDR
patches_modified.description: Plays the normal version of HDR videos, so your screen doesn't suddenly jump to full brightness. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Playback quality
patches_modified.description: Lets you choose the video quality, like highest, lowest or 720p, and set a lower quality for mobile data to use less data. Starts off. Pick a quality in Adrmodtt settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Playback speed
patches_modified.description: Remembers the speed you picked for the next video, and lets you set a default speed, add speeds up to 3x to the menu and choose the speed for press and hold. On by default. Turn it off in Adrmodtt settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Prefer H.264 playback
patches_modified.description: Plays videos in an older format your phone decodes more easily, which can help older phones play smoothly and run cooler. Videos without it play as before. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Profile background
patches_modified.description: Opens TikTok's own profile background editor in Edit profile on accounts TikTok hasn't offered it to yet, and shows the backgrounds other profiles have set. TikTok's servers may still refuse to save one for such an account. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Region spoof
patches_modified.description: Makes TikTok's region and time zone match the country you set for SIM spoof. It changes every region check, sign-in included, and its store region switch is experimental, so it isn't picked for you. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Region.

patches_modified.name: Remember clear display
patches_modified.description: Keeps clear display, TikTok's mode that hides the buttons over a video, on as you swipe to the next video (`Keep Clear display across videos` turns that part off). It can also turn on by itself after a delay you pick, which starts off in Adrmodtt settings > Feed screen. When clear display ends, the Following stories bubble TikTok hid comes back too.

patches_modified.name: Remove LIVE extras
patches_modified.description: Removes the script for games inside LIVEs and turns off animated gift effects. It saves very little space. The catch: LIVE games and animated gifts may stop working. Co-hosting, joining a LIVE as a guest, invitations and battle scores aren't touched.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes the files for LIVE co-hosting, joining a LIVE as a guest, matches, games and gift effects, so the app gets about 3 MB smaller. The catch: in LIVEs, battle scores and guest names can go missing, and joining someone's LIVE by voice or video, co-hosting, games or animated gifts may stop working.

patches_modified.name: Remove avatar rings
patches_modified.description: Takes the story and LIVE rings off profile pictures, so tapping a picture opens the profile instead of a story or LIVE. It can also open a LIVE creator's Story from their profile picture or their chat in the Inbox. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Remove content credential and card scanner assets
patches_modified.description: Removes TikTok's payment card scanner and content credential files, saving about 11 MB of storage. Anything in TikTok that needs them may stop working. Only patching again without it brings them back.

patches_modified.name: Remove creation tools
patches_modified.description: Removes two effects engine libraries TikTok doesn't load for the camera, effects, Retouch or the video editor, saving about 45 MB. Those all keep working. If a creation tool ever closes TikTok, repatch without this one.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes TikTok's camera, editing and effects files, saving about 38 MB of storage. The catch: the Create tab and every recording, editing and effects tool stop working, and opening one, like effect search, can close TikTok. Leave it out if you make videos.

patches_modified.name: Remove unused language packs
patches_modified.description: Removes the app languages you don't list in this patch's options, saving up to about 26 MB of storage. English is always kept. With no list it keeps them all. Only patching again brings removed ones back.

patches_modified.name: Remove voice tools
patches_modified.description: Removes TikTok's speech recognition files, saving about 16 MB of storage. The catch: voice search, naming a song by listening, talking to TikTok's AI assistant and TikTok's music check on videos you post all stop working. Only patching again without it brings them back.

patches_modified.name: Report a newer phone to effects
patches_modified.description: Tells TikTok's effects server you have a newer phone, so effects it turns down on older phones get another chance. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Repost diagnostics
patches_modified.description: With diagnostic logging on, notes when you repost a video and what TikTok answered, to help track down reposts that don't stick. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Resource and battery governor
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok reading your phone's motion sensors, which it can use to identify your phone, and stops a background speed test that can use a lot of memory. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Resume videos after scrolling
patches_modified.description: When you scroll back to a video, it picks up where you left off instead of starting over. On by default. Turn it off in Adrmodtt settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Run beside the store app
patches_modified.description: Lets a renamed copy of TikTok, made with Morphe's Clone app patch, sign in while the regular TikTok stays installed. Pick it together with Clone app. Google and Facebook sign-in won't work in the copy, so use email or phone.

patches_modified.name: SIM spoof
patches_modified.description: Makes TikTok see the SIM country and carrier you choose. It may not change your region, since TikTok also goes by your internet connection and account. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Region.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches_modified.description: Removes the tracking codes from TikTok links you share, so the link carries less about you. It can also swap tiktok.com for another site. On by default. Turn it off in Adrmodtt settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Settings
patches_modified.description: Adds the Adrmodtt settings page to TikTok, at the top of Settings and privacy. Pressing and holding For You at the top of the feed opens it too. That's where you turn Adrmodtt's features on and off. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Share sheet tools
patches_modified.description: Lets you hide people, apps and buttons you don't use from the share sheet, add apps you do use, and copy a video's link with one press on Share. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Share sheet.

patches_modified.name: Show LIVE search
patches_modified.description: Adds TikTok's search button inside the LIVE section where TikTok supports it, so you can look for LIVEs. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Show author region
patches_modified.description: Shows the country a video was posted from next to the creator's name. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Show commenter handle and region
patches_modified.description: Shows a commenter's @username in place of their display name and the country their account is set to after the comment's time. It can also give each commenter's name a color of its own. Each starts off. Turn them on in Adrmodtt settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Show engagement rate
patches_modified.description: Shows how many people liked, commented on, shared or saved a video compared with how many watched it, next to the creator's name. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Show exact counts
patches_modified.description: Shows likes, comments and other counts as full numbers, like 1,234,567 instead of 1.2M. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Show follow status
patches_modified.description: Shows on a profile whether that person follows you back, and marks accounts in your follow lists that don't. On by default. Turn it off in Adrmodtt settings > App. A separate switch adds the month an account was made. Optional local counts and appearance controls apply to your own profile.

patches_modified.name: Show the progress bar
patches_modified.description: Shows the progress bar on videos where TikTok hides it, so you can see how long a video is and skip around. On by default. Turn it off in Adrmodtt settings > Playback, where you can also show the time beside the bar or give it a bigger handle. Seek bars for video stories and sound previews are there too.

patches_modified.name: Show the progress bar thumbnail
patches_modified.description: Shows a small preview picture while you drag the progress bar, so you can find the part you want. On by default. Turn it off in Adrmodtt settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Skip content warnings
patches_modified.description: Plays videos without the warning screen you'd have to tap through first, and can hide the Check sources and Check your sources banners. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Skip first-launch setup
patches_modified.description: Skips TikTok's setup screens on a fresh install, like the interest picker and the swipe tutorial. Sign-in and age screens still show. Its switch is on once picked, since setup runs before you can reach settings. Turn it off in Adrmodtt settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Skip passkey sign-in
patches_modified.description: Lets you sign in another way, like your password or a code by email or text, when TikTok wants a passkey. Password managers won't hand a passkey to a patched app, so that step can't finish here. With the switch on, TikTok treats your phone as one without passkeys. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Skip the splash ad
patches_modified.description: Lets you stop the full-screen ad TikTok can show while it starts up. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Skip update checks
patches_modified.description: Lets you stop two background tasks TikTok uses to check for updates, one of them when your phone starts. Some in-app update prompts may stop. Play Store updates still work. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Stay on the video in full screen
patches_modified.description: When a video ends in TikTok's full screen view, it stays on that video instead of moving to the next one. Swiping still moves on. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Stop on-device AI profiling
patches_modified.description: Lets you stop TikTok's built-in AI engine from starting, so it doesn't get a copy of everything TikTok logs about your use. TikTok works as if the engine weren't there. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Stop recording watch history
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok adding the videos you watch to your Watch history. The catch: your views stop counting, and For You learns less about what you like. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Stop saving search history
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok saving your new searches on your phone. Older searches stay until you delete them, and TikTok's servers may keep their own record. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Stop search autoplay
patches_modified.description: Stops videos in search results from playing by themselves. Each one shows its cover until you open it, so searching stays quiet. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Stop video looping
patches_modified.description: Stops a video at its end instead of playing it again. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Story controls
patches_modified.description: Lets a story replay when it ends instead of moving on, and keeps a photo story on screen until you tap or swipe. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Subtitle tools
patches_modified.description: Lets you make captions bigger, change their background and keep them in clear display, bring back TikTok's captions switch where it's missing, and save subtitle files with downloaded videos. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Feed screen, and Downloads for subtitle files.

patches_modified.name: Swipe-left controls
patches_modified.description: Lets a left swipe on a video open its comments or do nothing, instead of opening the creator's profile. Starts off. Pick an action in Adrmodtt settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Translate comments
patches_modified.description: Translates comments as they load, using TikTok's own translator, so you don't have to tap Translate on each one. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > Comments, where more rows list languages TikTok's automatic translation should leave alone, keep videos in the language they were made in, pick the language translations come out in, and add TikTok's translate button beside the comment count.

patches_modified.name: Trust user certificates
patches_modified.description: Lets TikTok trust security certificates you install yourself, so a tool like mitmproxy can show what the app sends. The risk: anyone who gets a certificate onto your phone can read TikTok's traffic too. Use it only on a test phone.

patches_modified.name: Turn off haptics
patches_modified.description: Stops the little vibrations TikTok makes when you tap or hold things. Your keyboard and your phone's own vibrations stay. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Turn off screen transitions
patches_modified.description: Opens and closes TikTok's screens without the sliding animation, so moving around feels quicker. Swipes still follow your finger. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Use non-personalized search
patches_modified.description: Shows search results that aren't tailored to your account. Starts off. Turn it on in Adrmodtt settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Use system font

apps.app_name: JPTT - 行動裝置也能輕鬆瀏覽PTT!

patches_modified.name: Disable Play license check
patches_modified.description: Disables the Play Store license check, which a patched app always fails and which closes the app on launch. Needed by every patched build.

patches_modified.name: Fix article list loading
patches_modified.description: Drops the ANSI escape sequences JPTT's terminal emulator cannot parse, which otherwise swallow the screen content that follows them. Fixes the article list being stuck at 載入中, and keeps the next sequence PTT adds from breaking the app again.

patches_modified.name: Fix image links
patches_modified.description: Shows the picture for links an image host answers with a web page: an imgur album or .mp4, an address missing the i. subdomain, a meee.com.tw page. Only the preview and the full size image change, not the article text.

patches_modified.name: Fix photo upload in clones
patches_modified.description: Fixes taking a photo to upload when the Clone app patch has renamed the package. Changes nothing on a normal install.

patches_modified.name: Increase image cache size
patches_modified.description: Keeps the images of the article you are reading in memory, so they are not read again when you scroll back, and gives the memory back once the app has been in the background for a while. A disk cache behind it covers coming back after that.

patches_modified.name: More recent searches
patches_modified.description: Shows more of your recent search keywords in the article search dialog.

patches_modified.name: Patch settings
patches_modified.description: Adds a tab to JPTT's own settings where the options these patches add can be changed without patching the app again, and where every setting can be exported to a file and read back.

patches_modified.name: Play GIFs
patches_modified.description: Plays animated GIFs and WebPs in articles, which the app shows as their first frame. Needs Android 9 or later; the full size viewer still shows the first frame.

patches_modified.name: Preload article images
patches_modified.description: Downloads an article's images as soon as you open it instead of when you scroll to each one. Respects the app's own image loading settings.

patches_modified.name: Reconnect on return
patches_modified.description: Reconnects the moment you come back to the app, instead of leaving you on a countdown that grows to eight seconds. While an article is open it waits until you leave it or do something that needs PTT, so opening links does not log you in again every time.

patches_modified.name: Remove ads
patches_modified.description: Stops the banner, the rows inside articles and lists, and the ad the app falls back to when it thinks AdMob is blocked. No ad is requested at all, so nothing is downloaded and nothing is reported.

patches_modified.name: Search history actions
patches_modified.description: Long press a recent search keyword in the article search dialog to delete it, clear the history, or add a home screen shortcut that opens the board with that search. Shortcuts made from the 最近搜尋 tab open the search too.

patches_modified.name: Sharper images
patches_modified.description: Shows pictures at the resolution they are drawn at. The full size viewer no longer halves anything taller or wider than 2048 pixels, and previews are no longer decoded smaller than their frame. Uses more memory for large pictures.

patches_modified.name: Stop on bot detection
patches_modified.description: Shows PTT's message and stops when its DDoS/BOT detection turns the connection away, instead of showing it as garbled text and reconnecting into it every few seconds.

patches_modified.name: Stop on login ban
patches_modified.description: Shows PTT's message and stops when it temporarily bans the account from logging in, instead of sitting at 連線中 until the app is closed.

patches_modified.name: Wrap recent searches
patches_modified.description: Lays the recent search keywords out over several lines instead of one line you have to scroll sideways.

patches_modified.name: Customize navigation bar
patches_modified.description: Takes the bottom navigation buttons you pick off the bar, such as My Network, Post, Notifications, Jobs, Video or News. Each page still opens from the Menu and from links. Restart LinkedIn after changing the selection.

patches_modified.name: Dark app icon
patches_modified.description: Black launcher icon with the white "in", instead of LinkedIn's blue. Chosen when patching: a launcher icon cannot switch with dark mode on its own.

patches_modified.name: Disable double-tap like
patches_modified.description: Stops double tapping a post or photo from liking it.

patches_modified.name: Download media
patches_modified.description: Adds a download button to the full screen photo, video and document viewer. Documents (PDFs and carousels) are saved as one PDF.

patches_modified.name: Expand posts
patches_modified.description: Adds an option (off by default, turned on in BadFella Patches) to show posts expanded by default. Tapping the text collapses them.

patches_modified.name: Feed filters
patches_modified.description: Adds optional filters (off by default, turned on in BadFella Patches): focus mode, celebrations, job cards, reposts, posts from others' activity, "Recommended for you", video posts, games, the "New posts" pill and "See translation".

patches_modified.name: Glass navigation bar
patches_modified.description: Draws the navigation bar as a floating, translucent capsule with a spring selection pill and no press ripple.

patches_modified.name: GmsCore support
patches_modified.description: Makes "Continue with Google" work in patched LinkedIn by signing in through microG RE (GmsCore) instead of Google Play services. Needs microG RE installed and signed in to a Google account.

patches_modified.name: Hide Premium upsells
patches_modified.description: Removes Premium and AI upsell cards and banners, including on profiles and the Me panel.

patches_modified.name: Hide ads
patches_modified.description: Removes promoted, boosted and sponsored posts from the feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide bottom tabs
patches_modified.description: Adds switches to take My Network and Jobs out of the bottom bar.

patches_modified.name: Hide promoted jobs
patches_modified.description: Removes promoted job listings from the Jobs tab and job search.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested posts
patches_modified.description: Removes "Suggested" posts from outside your network from the feed.

patches_modified.name: Icon-only post actions
patches_modified.description: Adds a switch in BadFella Patches to show the Like, Comment, Repost and Send buttons under posts without their labels.

patches_modified.name: Install next to LinkedIn
patches_modified.description: Installs this build as a second LinkedIn beside your normal one, with its own data and sign-in. Pick its package name and app name in the patch's options. Works as soon as you patch it in.

patches_modified.name: Keep feed on reopen
patches_modified.description: Keeps your place in the feed when you come back to LinkedIn, instead of reloading it. Pull down or tap the "New posts" button to load new posts.

patches_modified.name: Material You
patches_modified.description: Uses wallpaper colors (Android 12+) or a preset/custom accent color (Android 10+) instead of LinkedIn blue and the green of selected filters, and Material 3 surface colors for backgrounds, cards, bars and borders. Some screens drawn by LinkedIn's servers may keep their own colors.

patches_modified.name: Material icons in the bottom bar
patches_modified.description: Replaces LinkedIn's Home, My Network, Notifications, Jobs and Video tab icons with Material icons (filled when selected, outlined otherwise). Chosen when patching.

patches_modified.name: Messaging
patches_modified.description: Hides sponsored messages, and adds an optional ghost mode that does not send typing indicators or read status.

patches_modified.name: More tab
patches_modified.description: Lets you hide items of the More tab (Puzzle games, Groups, Events, Newsletters), or list them at the bottom of the profile menu.

patches_modified.name: Navigation bar
patches_modified.description: Adds options (turned on in BadFella Patches) to hide the More, Jobs, Network and Notifications tabs of the navigation bar, its count badges and its labels.

patches_modified.name: Open links directly
patches_modified.description: Opens external links without LinkedIn's safety/go warning page.

patches_modified.name: Pitch black
patches_modified.description: Replaces the gray backgrounds of dark mode with black, and cards with a slightly lighter black, across the entire app. Takes effect when the system is in dark mode. Works with or without Material You.

patches_modified.name: Post menu items
patches_modified.description: Adds Copy text, Download photos and videos, and Save document as PDF to the ⋯ menu of posts, each with its own icon.

patches_modified.name: Remove gaps and dividers
patches_modified.description: Removes the gray gaps between posts and the dividers between list items, so the feed and lists are one flat surface.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize share links
patches_modified.description: Removes tracking parameters from LinkedIn links when they are copied or shared.

patches_modified.name: Swipe between feeds
patches_modified.description: Swipe left and right on the home feed to switch between For you and Network, like on X.

patches_modified.name: Swipe between tabs
patches_modified.description: Swipe sideways to go to the next or previous tab of the navigation bar.

patches_modified.name: Tap to hide in viewers
patches_modified.description: Tap a video or document in full screen to hide the caption and buttons, like photos.

patches_modified.description: Disables declared analytics and crash collection and removes advertising permissions. Keeps Firebase Messaging and location permissions. Does not guarantee zero tracking.

patches_modified.name: Restore notifications
patches_modified.description: Restores Firebase certificate metadata on re-signed apps, with an Android 17 compatible token setup. Push delivery still requires device testing.

patches_modified.name: Restore reminder alarms
patches_modified.description: Restores task/reminder alarm scheduling on re-signed apps.

patches_added.description: Stops playback (audio/video) when the app is minimized or exited, so nothing keeps playing in the background. Open a stream again to resume playback. Toggle it in SEYTTINGS. Requires the SEYTTINGS patch.

patches_added.name: Seasonal sidebar banner
patches_added.description: Shows a picture in the sidebar header that changes with the season, or one you choose. If you set it back to Joey's image, any picture Joey had already saved is still there and gets used again.

patches_modified.name: Modern UI
patches_modified.description: [v1.4.0: Post actions editor for the post bar and ⋮ menu. Full screen media, optionally opening without controls. New album viewer with thumbnails, grid and captions. Separate Modern fonts. Sidebar subreddit search keyboard fixed. Performance improvements, comparably smooth to Joey or better.] A cleaner layout for Joey, on by default, with a choice of themes. Settings in Joey Settings - Morphe Settings.
patches_modified.previous_description: [v1.3.7: AMOLED black now appears in settings. v1.3.6: Classic Joey can be turned back on. The Joey bird image in sidebar can be toggled on when using ModernUI. Thumbnail post style ui fixes.] With ModernUI layout turned on (on by default) Joey's own themes and colour changes are turned off. ModernUI layout patch includes Aqua (default), Blue, Purple, Coral, Mint, Gold, Amber, Black, Sky, and AMOLED black themes and can be set in Joey Settings - Morphe Settings. Posts use one compact list, so card and compact are no longer separate. Various customisable UI options are in Morphe Settings. The media viewer has its first UI tweaks in this release, including bigger icons and a full screen view.

patches_added.name: Disable Beeline telemetry
patches_added.description:
Stops Beeline from sending usage and crash telemetry to remote servers.

Disables:
- Segment Analytics (track / screen / identify events)
- Firebase Analytics (logEvent)
- Firebase Crashlytics (log messages, recorded exceptions)
- Mapbox map telemetry (events collection switched off at the SDK level)

Does not affect app functionality — only telemetry collection is
suppressed. Navigation, routing, maps and Plus features all keep working.

patches_modified.name: Unlock Beeline Plus features
patches_modified.description: Unlocks Beeline plus features such as round-trip generation, live traffic and premium map types.
